name: CHRIST
tagline: One AI voice system, assembled from every project in this tree.

layers.name: Protocol
layers.blurb: The wire everything else agrees on.

layers.name: Voice plane
layers.blurb: Where a call exists: signalling, media, routing, the SIP border.

layers.name: VoiceOps
layers.blurb: Numbers, people, records, mail and messages — the customer-facing telephony.

layers.name: AgentOps
layers.blurb: The agents themselves and the runtime that speaks on a call.

layers.name: AI
layers.blurb: What makes an agent intelligent: prompts, models, memory, knowledge.

layers.name: Tools
layers.blurb: What an agent or an operator can do with its hands.

projects.name: Cantus
projects.role: The standard, plus a dependency-free Perl reference stack that proves it: one signed UDP flow carries both signalling and media, and the routing document is normative here.

projects.name: cantus-switch
projects.role: The switch every other process talks to: lines, trunks, calls, bridging, recording, the routing document, a control API, an ARI-compatible surface and the browser softphone socket.

projects.name: cantus-gateway
projects.role: The SIP border: one Cantus endpoint on the inside, one carrier trunk on the outside, PCM16 to PCMU in between, with SDES-SRTP as a switch. The only process in the estate that speaks SIP.

projects.name: Telno
projects.role: The platform, and the VoiceOps role this tree fills without zeus: accounts, numbers, extensions, trunks, IVR, voicemail, CDRs, billing and the browser softphone. It owns the inventory and generates the routing document; it never sees a datagram.

projects.name: Capstone
projects.role: AgentOps: the agent definitions, the workflow studio, the dashboards and the supervision that keeps dograh running — and the switch-side scripts that make every agent number dialable.

projects.name: Dograh
projects.role: The voice-agent runtime: an ARI application that takes the call, streams external media over a WebSocket and runs STT, LLM and TTS around it. Its dialect is unchanged — the switch serves ARI so it did not have to be rewritten.
contributes: the speaking half of every agent

projects.name: Soulforge
projects.role: CodeOps for agent identity: a soul — identity, voice dials, principles, boundaries — compiled live into a system prompt, with a streaming playground against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. CHRIST compiles the estate's souls from this format.
contributes: the playground that tests a prompt before a caller meets it

projects.name: OmniRoute
projects.role: The model gateway: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of many providers and routing strategies, with fallback and token compression. Point it at local models and no token leaves the box.
contributes: the LLM endpoint every agent and editor uses

projects.name: claude-mem
projects.role: Agent memory: captures what an agent did, compresses it and injects it into the next session, so a caller who rang yesterday is not a stranger today. Vendored unmodified.

projects.name: OnTrak
projects.role: TrainingOps: a graded IT-support range with Tix, Sentinel and Sync. It is where an agent's knowledge is given a score, and where a call that needs a human becomes a ticket rather than a dropped line.
contributes: the service desk a call escalates into

projects.name: ontrak-mcp
projects.role: The MCP client and tool bridge: lets an agent console use tools that live in another process — a database, a browser driver, REA — over stdio, with no runtime dependency.
contributes: one bridge for every MCP server

projects.name: REA
projects.role: Reverse engineering as an MCP tool: turns a shipped artifact or a live capture into evidence, which is how a carrier's or a softphone's real behaviour gets answered with a trace instead of a guess.

projects.name: OpenSMS
projects.role: The SMS channel: an Android phone on your own network becomes the SMS API, so messaging needs no gateway vendor and no monthly bill. Capstone's SMS_PROVIDER can point straight at it.

projects.name: Loomix Mail
projects.role: Mail, calendars and files over JMAP on your own Stalwart server — where a voicemail, its transcript and an agent's summary land when the call ends.
contributes: one sign-in for mail and calendar

projects.name: Onyx
projects.role: The terminal coding agent that runs on the estate's own gateway: any model through OmniRoute, no account, no telemetry. The operator's hands on the box that answers the phone.
